answer: A sybil farm must reproduce that entire spiral history for every fake identity, so forging N nodes costs N times the original stake plus wasted compute; honest agents pay once and reuse their receipt, making mass impersonation economically irrational. Each agent must stake a pearl of verified compute, and the protocol colors it an umber receipt bound to a spiral of prior epoch signatures. In practice, Agent0264 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
